story_fall.visual_notes: Selected attempt 2 of 3. Four shard trails, recognizable dawn island, one of each hero, Wren grips the rope, empty broken cradle. **Visual flags:** Kit has a third fin instead of two; Wren has two mechanical arms instead of only her anatomical left; Cade's upper boot slightly intersects the 16:9 crop. Pockets cameo absent (the wave asks for only these three heroes). Faces remain above narration. Attempt 3 fixes the extra fin and Wren's right arm but drops Cade's face into the narration strip, so it was rejected. Requires parent review; no further attempts under the three-attempt production limit.
